notes.title: Patch 1.5.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]A Quality of Life Patch.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Drop area detection on all sound banks has been enlarged.
[*] Previewing assets no longer loop, they only play once.
[*] We added more Love!
[/list]


[b]If you have a suggestion for a DLC pack please get in contact with us! [/b]

[h1]Please leave a Steam review if you are enjoying Ambient DM.[/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.5 Is Live
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.5[/h1]

[h1]** WE HEARD YOU LOUD AND CLEAR **[/h1]

This is a major patch to Ambient DM. We have had many requests for these additions and changes.

[u]1. Your Mouse Scroll Wheel now works on the sounds lists!

2. Click a Sound Button to preview the sound, click it again to end the preview.

3. Commercial DLC will be available any day. Steam is reviewing it!
[/u]

[h1]AND THE BIG ONE...[/h1]

[u]4. Custom sound files are now usable in Ambient DM*[/u]

[i]* Due to MP3 licensing, your custom sound files must be in "Ogg Vorbis" format. If you have never heard of this format before, that's okay. You can use free software like "Audacity" to convert or record your own files.. again.. for free![/i]



[h1]Instructions for using Custom Sound Files[/h1]

Just click on the "OGGS Folder" button on the main menu and it will open the custom files folder for you. Put your .Ogg files inside that folder and restart Ambient DM. Now all of your custom files will be available to you on the OGGs Tab in game!

There are also these same instructions in the OGGs folder incase you forget what you read here.
